description.en:
Deals [9_dark:dark] damage to one target.
Slain living units are raised as skeletons.
Raised skeletons have max HP equal to that of the slain unit, and deal [5_physical:physical] damage in melee.
Skeletons of flying units can fly.
Deathbolt grants 1 [damage] to your Dark spells and skills whenever it slays a target, lasts until next realm.
Deathbolt also deals [ice] damage
Raised skeletons are Chaos skeletons, gaining resistances, a chaos ball attack, and spawning a number of imps on death proportional to their max hp.
Deals [9:damage] [fire] damage to units in a [2_tile:radius] burst.
Fireball randomly deals [physical], [lightning], or [fire] damage.  If a unit is resistant to one or more of these damage types, fireball deals the damage type that unit is least resistant to.
Fireball gains 1 [radius] for every 4 tiles away that you cast it, and never damages the wizard or their allies.
Units in the center tile take extra [physical] damage and are stunned for [3:duration] turns.
Fireball blinds and poisons units for [4:duration] turns.

Deal [6_physical:physical] damage to the target.
Then, deal [6_ice:ice] to the target and a [1_tile:radius] area around it.
If cast on a chasm tile, creates a floor tile.
Freeze the main target for 2 turns
Deals [physical] damage to all units in a beam to the main target

Deals lightning damage to all units in the radius.
Icicle can be cast on any tile containing a cloud.
Deals [Poison] and [Dark] damage to the main target. Reduces a random resistance by 10%.
Deals [3_dark:dark] damage to target unit each turn for [15_turns:duration], healing the caster for the same amount.
Lifedrain also heals [2:num_targets] random [living] allies.
Lifedrain also drains life from [2:num_targets] random enemy units up to [3_tiles:radius] away from the target.
Lifedrain can be cast without line of sight
Deals [12_lightning:lightning] damage in a beam.
Lightning bolt can be channeled for up to 10 turns.
Whenever Lightning Bolt kills a unit, spawn a living lightning scroll that can cast your Lightning Bolt spell once.
Lightning bolt also deals [arcane] damage
Deal [11_arcane:arcane] damage to the target.
Magic Missile removes all SH from the target before dealing damage.
If Magic Missile targets an [arcane] unit, it deals [dark] and [holy] damage instead of [arcane].
When you cast Magic Missile, up to [4:num_targets] additional missiles are fired from [arcane] allies in line of sight of the target.
Magic Missile bounces up to [2:num_targets] times to targets in range and line of sight of the target.

Deal [9_physical:physical] damage to target unit.
That unit is [poisoned] for [30_turns:duration].
[Poisoned] units take 1 [poison] damage each turn and cannot heal.
Damaged targets lose all poison resist
Stuns target and spawns webs along a line to the target.  Webs stun enemy units that enter them for 2 turns.
Hits every poisoned enemy in a radius of 3 of the main target.
Summon a wolf with a leap attack.
Summons a pack of [3:num_summons] wolves instead of just 1.
A random boss modifier is applied to the wolf.
Summon a Werewolf instead of a wolf.

Summon Fenris instead of a wolf.
Consumes all remaining charges on cast.
For each charge consumed, Fenris gains the damage and health of your wolf.
Each time Fenris kills a unit, he grows more powerful.
Deals [16_fire:fire] damage, [16_lightning:lightning] damage, and [16_physical:physical] damage to the target.
Remaining hits from Annihilate will jump to nearby targets if the main target is killed
Annihilate deals additional [dark] and [arcane] damage hits
Annihilate chains to up to [5:num_targets] units standing in storms in line of sight
If you are able, when you cast this spell, use an additional charge to cast it again if the target lives.

All allied units gain stacking 6 [damage] bonus to their [fire] and [physical] abilities.
Lasts [7_turns:duration].
Boiling Blood also impacts [holy] and [dark] abilities
Affected units receive a [fire] damage aura and a death explosion effect which scales with their health.
Boiling Blood becomes permanent, but causes affected units to take 1 [fire] damage per turn.

Deals [16_physical:physical] damage to all units in a line.
This spell can target and destroy a wall tile.
Bone Spear also deals [fire] damage.
Whenever the spear kills a unit, enemy units within a [3_tile:radius] radius take [16_poison:poison] damage.
Bone Spear applies stun for [3:duration] turns

Fire [9_bolts:num_targets] of chaotic energy at random units in a cone.
Each bolt randomly deals [6_fire:fire], [6_lightning:lightning], or [6_physical:physical] damage.
Each bolt also deals damage to adjacent enemies
Chaos barrage ignores allies, and always uses the damage type the target resists the least

Teleport all units in a [4_tile:radius] radius to random locations
The caster is unaffected.
Casts Magic Missile on all teleported enemy units
Teleported allied units in the radius gain 3 SH
Teleported units receive [10_turns:duration] of Silence and Poisoned

Dreamwalk for [5:duration] turns.  Afterwards, you are returned to the location you cast it at, restored to the HP you cast it at.
Casting Dreamwalk while already active will end the current walk.
While dreamwalking, gain 75% resistance to [arcane], [dark], [physical], and [holy] damage.
Damage from [dark] spells and skills while dreamwalking inflict 1 turn of fear.
When dreamwalk ends, reset all [Translocation] spell charge counts to what they were at the beginning of the walk.

Every [3_turns:shot_cooldown], deals [10_dark:dark] damage to a random enemy unit in line of sight, healing the caster for damage dealt.
Lasts [20_turns:duration].
Eye of Blood instead casts your Lifedrain spell for free.
Increase shot cooldown by 3. Shoots at all targets in line of sight
When it deals damage, the target's max HP is reduced by the damage dealt, a Blood Slime is summoned nearby.

Every [3_turns:shot_cooldown], deals [15_fire:fire] damage to a random enemy unit in line of sight.
Lasts [30_turns:duration].
Eye of Fire instead casts your Immolate spell
Eye of Fire summons a Flaming Eyeball on expiration
Whenever eye of fire kills an enemy, it fires again

Every [3_turns:shot_cooldown], deals [15_ice:ice] damage to a random enemy unit in line of sight.
Lasts [30_turns:duration].
Eye of Ice summons a Frosty Eyeball on expiration.
You can have multiple instances of Eye of Ice active simultaneously.
Eye of Ice casts your Iceball spell.

Every [3_turns:shot_cooldown], deals [15_lightning:lightning] damage to a random enemy unit in line of sight.
Lasts [30_turns:duration].
Allies along the beam are healed for [15:damage] and gain [1_SH:shields]
Eye of Lightning casts your Thunderstrike spell.
Eye of Lightning applies a non-stacking -50 Lightning resist to target.

Every [3_turns:shot_cooldown], inflict [berserk] on a random enemy unit in line of sight for [2_turns:berserk].
Lasts [20_turns:duration].
When Eye of Rage targets a [living] unit with 25% or less HP, that unit is instantly killed and raised as a friendly Werewolf.  That Werewolf is berserked for 14 turns.
Eye of Rage targets a connected group
Targeted units gain a fiery aura that damages nearby units.

Deal [9_fire:fire] damage to all units in a cone.
This spell can be channeled for up to [10_turns:duration].  The effect is repeated each turn the spell is channeled.
Fan of Flames heals allies instead of damaging them.
Fan of flames also deals [Ice] damage.
Fan of Flames gains 1 range for the next turn for each enemy unit killed.

Summon a floating eye.
Floating eyes have [1_HP:minion_health], [4_SH:shields], fly, and passively blink.
Floating eyes vanish after [16_turns:minion_duration].
Floating Eye can cast your Petrify on a 3 turn cooldown.
Floating Eye can cast your other level 2 [eye:eye] spells on 15 turn cooldowns.
Floating Eye gains 2 SH per turn up to 4 SH.

Target unit is [frozen] for [5_turns:duration].
[Frozen] units cannot act. Frozen units unfreeze upon taking [fire] or [physical] damage.
The target is refrozen every turn for the duration.
Freeze a connected group of enemies.
Casting freeze only takes half a turn
Summon a Goatia.
The Goatia reincarnates once upon death
The Goatia deals [5:minion_damage] [dark] damage to any unit that damages it
On death, the Goatia spawns [2:num_summons] mind maggots
Heal all allies in line of sight for [25_health:heal].
Allies in line of sight gain 1 shield
Allies in line of sight lose all debuffs before being healed
Whenever Healing Light heals an ally, the nearest enemy in line of sight of that ally takes that much [fire] and [holy] damage.
Deal [14_holy:holy] damage to enemies and heal allies for [14_hp:heal] along a beam and in a [1_tile:radius] burst.
Slain enemies create temporary spirits.  Spirits are blinking holy undead with 4 hitpoints and a 2 damage ranged holy attack.
Affected ally units gain 2 SH
Affected ally units are re-healed for half the initial amount each turn for 5 turns.

Summons a hungry maw.
The maw is shielded, floats, and is stationary.
The maw has a ranged [physical] attack, which pulls enemies towards it.
The maw vanishes after [15_turns:minion_duration].
Hungry Maw gains a [physical] melee attack which attacks [4:num_targets] times
Hungry Maw gains a wall melting arcane beam attack

Deals [14_ice:ice] damage in a [2_tile:radius] burst.
Affected units in the area are [frozen] for [3_turns:duration].
Gains +2 radius and x2 damage if cast on a Blizzard tile. The Blizzard tile is consumed.
Units inside of the area of effect which are already frozen take physical damage before being refrozen.
Whenever you cast Iceball, summon 1 ice faery for every 4 enemies it damages.

Target enemy takes [3_fire:fire] damage each turn for [8_turns:duration].
This damage increases by [3_damage:damage] each turn.
Immolate also affects a connected group of enemies.
Immolate inflicts [3_turns:duration] of blind and deals half damage to units in a [3_tile:radius] radius around the target each turn.
When an immolated enemy dies, regain a charge of a random [dragon] spell you know.
Immolate gains permanent duration

Each living ally attacks a random enemy unit in melee range.
The attack deals [14_physical:physical] damage and inflicts [2_turns:duration] of [stun].
Poisons targets for 10 turns.
Instead of a melee attack, do a leap attack with a range of [3:radius].
Every 3 kills gain a wolf charge.

Magnetize target metallic unit.
Enemy units within a [4_tile:radius] radius of the magnetized unit are pulled [1_tiles:range] towards the unit each turn.
Afterwards, adjacent enemy units are stunned for 1 turn. and take [3_lightning:lightning] damage.
Lasts [10_turns:duration].

Lowers target's [lightning:lightning] and [arcane:arcane] resist by 75. 
 Deals [poison] damage to all units in range each turn.
Deals [lightning:lightning] damage to all units in range rather than just adjacent units.
Casts your Mercurize with [1_duration:duration] on adjacent enemy units.
Magnetism can now target living units.
Target unit takes [22_fire:fire] damage and loses [100_physical:physical] resist.
Create 2 fire slimes when Melt kills its target.
Chains to up to [6:num_targets] adjacent enemies.

Afflict the target with Mercurize.  The target takes [2_poison:poison] and [2_physical:physical] damage each turn for [6_turns:duration].
If the target dies while cursed, it is raised as a Quicksilver Geist.
Geists are flying undead metallic units with many resistances and immunities.
The Geist has max HP equal to the cursed unit, and an attack dealing [10_physical:physical] damage.
The Geist disappears after [32_turns:minion_duration]
Mercurized targets also take [dark] damage
When a Quicksilver Geist is killed, its killer is afflicted with Mercurize.
At the end of their turn, units affected by Mercurize with less than half health are berserked for the remainder of its duration

Deals [7_arcane:arcane] and [7_physical:physical] damage in a line to target empty tile.
The glaive will linger on the target tile for 1 turn, and return at the end of your next turn, dealing damage again.
Deals [1_arcane:arcane] damage to all enemies in LOS of the target.  This damage is fixed and cannot be buffed.
Deals [7_lightning:lightning] damage to up to [3:num_targets] enemies up to [2_tiles:radius] away from the blade's destination.

Pull all enemies within [4_tiles:radius] toward the blade.
The blade now lingers at the target tile for [3:duration] turns.

Inflict [petrify] on the target for [10_turns:duration].
[Petrified] units cannot act.
[Petrified] units gain [100_ice:ice] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [100_lightning:lightning] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [75_physical:physical] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [75_fire:fire] resist.
Turn the target to glass instead of stone.  Glass targets have -100 physical resist.
Target loses [100_arcane:arcane] resist.
On death, raise target as a golem.
Enemies in line of sight of the target are feared for [1:duration] turn.

Curse a group of [living] enemy units with the essence of undeath.
Affected units become [undead] and lose [living].
Affected units lose [25%:damage] of their max HP.
Affected units take [1_poison:poison] damage per turn.
Affected units lose [100_holy:holy] resist.
Affected units gain [100_dark:dark] resist.
Affected units cannot be healed.
Raise killed units as zombies.
The curse spreads from cursed units to adjacent living enemies each turn.

Deal [16_fire:fire] damage in a beam.
Deal [16_lightning:lightning] damage to tiles adjacent to the beam.
Add a [physical] damage layer.
[Lightning:lightning] damage arcs to [2:num_targets] enemy units in line of sight.
Secondary beams triggered from the target to up to [2:num_targets] random enemies in line of sight of the target.
Summons fire spirits for units killed by the [fire] beam, and spark spirits for those killed by the [lightning] beams.
Creates a Rain Storm.  Units caught within are Soaked, lowering their [ice] and [lightning] resistances, but raising their [fire] resistance.
The rainclouds deal [9_poison:poison] damage each turn
The wizard and their allies are healed for 7 hp per turn while they are in the rainclouds
Each turn for [8_turns:duration], all allied units in a [10_tile:radius] radius are healed for [4_HP:heal].
The aura heals all allies on the level
When you cast this spell, allies in range gain the ability to reincarnate on death

The target is stunned for [5_turns:duration].
Each turn, the target and all units within [1_tiles:radius] take [5_holy:holy] damage.
When a enemy Scourged [Demon] dies, casts a random Holy conjuration you know.
Targeting an enemy applies Scourged to a connected group of enemies.
Target is feared for [5_turns:duration] after Scourged ends.

Deals [12:damage] [poison] damage to units in a [3_tile:radius] burst
If cast on an allied [slime] unit, it will explode, adding its max hp to the damage dealt by the spell.
Inflict [10:duration] turns of Soaked on non [slime] units.
Cast your Slimify on affected enemy units.

Storms in the affected area get turned into slimes of matching types.
Lightning Storms spawn Electric Slimes
Blizzards spawn Ice Slimes
Rain Clouds spawn Green Slimes

Slimeshot deals [physical] damage in addition to [poison].
Affected units receive [Slime_Rust:slime] which reduces all of their resistances by 10%
Does not affect [Slime] units.
Swap places with a friendly [undead] unit.
Soul Swap can target enemy undead units as well.
Swapped [undead] gains your Death Bolt on a 3 turn cooldown.

Target unit loses up to [1:damage] max HP, and you gain that many SH.
 This will not kill units.

Deal [24_lightning:lightning] damage to the target.
Stun all enemies in a [2_tile:radius] burst around the target.
Thunderstrike can be cast without line of sight
Charge cost is refunded if the target tile already has a thunder storm.
Thunder Strike also deals holy damage
Deal [200_dark:dark] damage to one unit in melee range.
Touch of Death also deals [fire] damage.
When a [living] target dies to touch of death, it is raised as a friendly Vampire.
Touch of death hits up to [4:num_targets] more adjacent targets
Touch of death deals additional damage equal to the target's max HP.

Summons [2:num_summons] Mushbooms.
Mushbooms have [11_HP:minion_health].
Mushbooms have a ranged attack dealing [1_poison:poison] damage and inflicting [4_turns:duration] of [poison].
Mushbooms inflict [12_turns:duration] of [poison] on units in melee range when they die.
Summon grey mushbooms instead, which apply stun instead of poison.
Summon red mushbooms instead, which do not apply poison but deal fire damage
Summon glass mushbooms instead, which apply glassify instead of poison

Deal [1_poison:poison] damage and inflict [poison] on all units in a [4_tile:radius] radius for [20_turns:duration].
[Poisoned] units take 1 [poison] damage each turn and cannot heal.
All allies in the radius are healed instead of damaged and poisoned.
Toxin Burst also deals [15_dark:dark] damage.
Summons a Poison Bomber in the center of the burst that deals [15_poison:poison] damage.
Affected units are afflicted with blinded and soaked for [5_turns:duration]

Swap places with target unit.
That unit takes [16_arcane:arcane] damage.
Cannot target [arcane] immune units.
Casts your Petrify on the target.
Aether Swap can be cast without line of sight
Casting Aether Swap only takes half a turn

Allied [slime] units in a connected group are amalgamated onto the target.
The target gains the max hp, resists, spells, and spell damage, of the affected units.
Target loses the base slime buff, and gains the Slimy boss buff.
This spell must target a friendly [slime] unit.
Affects all friendly slimes in the level instead of those in a connected group

You may target yourself with this spell.
Casting it on yourself causes you to ignore its other effects and heal for the total health of slimes absorbed.
Slimes steal [1:damage] max hp from adjacent enemy units before amalgamating

Instead of consolidating into the target slime, summons a random monster with the slimy boss modifier.
The monster summoned depends on the total health of the absorbed slimes, with higher health pools yielding more powerful monsters.
The summoned monster's health is set to the total health of the absorbed slimes.

Summon an arcane orb next to the caster.
The orb can cast your magic missile spell.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by arcane damage.
Arcane Orb casts your Blazerip spell instead of your Magic Missile spell.
Arcane Orb fires twice.
Targeting an existing arcane orb detonates it, casting your Magic Missile [12:num_targets] times.

Whenever an enemy unit targets you with a spell or attack, that unit is [petrified] for [2:duration] turns.
Lasts [15_turns:duration].
Affected enemies are also [poisoned] for [15:duration] turns.
Your [Dragon] allies also receive the buff when you cast this spell.
Casts your Petrify spell on enemies instead.

Deals [12_arcane:arcane] and [12_fire:fire] damage in a [7_tile:radius] line perpendicular to the caster.
Melts walls in the affected area.
Blazerip also affects a symmetric area behind the player.
Inflicts Aether Poison on units it hits. Aether Poison lasts [10:duration] turns, and deals [1_arcane:damage] damage per turn, and causes the enemy to lose 50 [arcane] resistance during the duration.
On kill, summon a swarm of either Fae Flies or Burning Flies.

[Blind] all units in line of sight of the caster for [4_turns:duration].
[Blind] units have all their spell ranges reduced to 1.
Deals [5_holy:holy] damage to affected [undead] and [demon] units.
Deals [1_turn:duration] of stun to all enemy units.
Deals [5_fire:fire] damage to all enemy units in LOS.
Casting Blinding Light only takes half a turn
Teleport to target tile.
Blink can be cast without line of sight
Casting blink also casts disperse
Casting blink casts thunderstrike on the [2:num_targets] closest enemy targets in line of sight.

Enemies in a [4_tile:radius] burst take [18_dark:dark] damage.
Whenever an enemy is dealt damage this way, you or a random wounded ally in the targeted area is healed for half that amount.
Affected enemies are Frozen for [3_turns:duration]
Bloodshift also deals [poison] damage, though this damage does not cause healing.
You and only you are healed by this spell, even if you are out of the targeted area.

Fire an arcing bolt of electricity dealing [12_lightning:lightning] damage.
The bolt repeatably arcs to new targets within the cascade range.
Each arc deals damage to all units along a beam.
The bolt can arc up to [5_tiles:cascade_range], and cannot pass through walls.
The bolt terminates when it cannot arc to any new targets.
Cast Fireball for free on each target chain lightning bounces to
Chain Lightning can arc to blizzards, rain clouds, and storm clouds

Chain Lightning can arc to friendly targets.
Friendly units hit by Chain Lightning gain 1 SH, up to a max of 3, instead of damaged.

Summons a choir of [4:num_summons] angelic singers.
The singers have [10_HP:minion_health], [1_SH:shields], 50% resistance to [fire] and [holy] damage, and 100% resistance to [dark] damage.
The angels can sing, dealing [2_fire:fire] and [2_holy:holy] damage to all [undead], [demon], and [dark] units in a [5_tile:radius] radius. [Living] and [holy] units in the song's radius are healed for [1_HP:heal].
The angels vanish after [10:minion_duration] turns.
Angels can cast your Death Bolt on a 4 turn cooldown.
When an enemy is healed for a cumulative total more than its max health, it becomes an ally.

Each turn, [blind] all units for [1_turn:duration].
[Blind] units have all their spell ranges reduced to 1.
Lasts [5_turns:duration]
Doesn't blind you or your allies
Deal [5_dark:dark] damage to all enemies under clouds each turn.

Deal [11_dark:dark] damage to the target each turn for [5_turns:duration].
If the target dies during this time, deals [11_ice:ice] damage and inflicts [frozen] for [5_turns:duration] on all enemies within a [3_tile:radius] radius.
[Frozen] units cannot act. Frozen units unfreeze upon taking [fire] or [physical] damage.
Raise slain [living] units as Icy Skeletons.
Also deals [poison] damage to main target.
Applies Death Chill to a connected group of enemies.
Devour an allied [living] unit to heal yourself for its current hp.
Instead of killing the target, only steal as much HP as you are missing.
Also heal allies in a 2 tile radius.
Slain Living units are raised as Burning Skeletons.

Deal [24_arcane:arcane] and [24_dark:dark] damage to an enemy unit.
Then, if the target is under 50% HP, deal that damage again.
If this kills the target, they are raised as a zombie.
Can only target [living], [demon], and [arcane] units.
Zombies raised by this spell can cast it on a 7 turn cooldown.
If Devour Mind kills the target, heal for the half the target's max HP

Devour Mind deals [ice] damage in addition to [arcane] and [dark].
If the target lives, they are [frozen:ice] for [3:duration] turns.
Additionally, each of their abilities gains +[3:duration] cooldown.
Target enemy unit with no more than [40_max_HP:heal] becomes your minion.
Increase the maximum HP units which can be targeted
Dominate targets based on current hp instead of maximum hp.
Transforms the target into a lich.
Dominated targets gain your Dominate spell on a 30 turn cooldown.

Summon an Earth Elemental.
Earth elementals have [120_HP:minion_health], [50_physical:physical] resist, [50_fire:fire] resist, [50_lightning:lightning] resist, and cannot move.
Earth elementals have a melee attack which deals [20_physical:physical] damage.
The elemental vanishes after [15_turns:minion_duration].
Earthen Sentinel gains your Earthquake spell on a 3 turn cool down.
Earthen Sentinel gains your Poison Sting spell.
Earthen Sentinel gains your Heavenly Blast spell on a 2 turn cool down.

Whenever you cast a [fire] spell, summon a fire elemental at the target of that spell.
Fire elementals have [22_HP:minion_health], [100_fire:fire] resist, [50_physical:physical] resist, and [-50_ice:ice] resist.
Fire elementals have an attack which deals [7_fire:fire] damage with a [4_tile:minion_range] range.
Fire elementals vanish after [9_turns:minion_duration].
This effect ends if you move or cast a spell without the [fire] tag.
Elemental attacks gain 1 radius.
Your elementals instantly cast your Eye of Fire spell when summoned
Starfire Gate can sustain off of both [Fire] and [Arcane] spells. Starfire Gate summons Starfire Elementals instead of Fire Elementals.

Deal [1:damage] [fire] damage to enemy units in a [1_tile:radius] radius around you each turn.
This radius increases by 1 each time you cast a [fire] spell.

Summon a frostfire hydra.
The hydra has [16_HP:minion_health], and is stationary.
The hydra has a beam attack which deals [7_fire:fire] damage with a [9_tile:minion_range] range.
The hydra has a beam attack which deals [7_ice:ice] damage with a [9_tile:minion_range] range.
The hydra vanishes after [15_turns:minion_duration].
50% of damage dealt by Frostfire Hydra is redealt as Arcane damage.
Frostfire Hydra's Ice beam freezes units for 2 turns.

Deal [11_dark:dark] damage to enemy units in a [1_tile:radius] radius.
Summon ghosts at empty tiles in the radius.
Ghosts have [4_HP:minion_health], fly, [100_physical:physical] resist, [50_dark:dark] resist, and passively blink.
Ghosts have a melee attack which deals [1_dark:dark] damage.
The ghosts vanish after [14_turns:minion_duration].

Curses affected enemies with Haunted, which summons a ghost near them each turn.
Lasts for [10:duration] turns.
A Ghost King is summoned at the center of the ghost ball.
A Ghostly Mass is summoned at the center of the ghost ball.

Summon a giant bear.
The bear has [75_HP:minion_health].
The bear has a melee attack which deals [10_physical:physical] damage.
Summons a metallic bear instead of a giant bear.
Summons a venom bear instead of a giant bear.  Venom Bears have a poison bite, and heal whenever an enemy takes poison damage.
Summons a blood bear instead of a giant bear.  Blood bears are resistant to dark damage, and deal increasing damage with each attack.

Summon a glass orb next to the caster.
Each turn the orb inflicts [glassify] on enemy units in a [3_tile:radius] area.
[Glassified] units cannot act.
[Glassified] units gain [-100_physical:physical] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [100_ice:ice] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [100_lightning:lightning] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [75_fire:fire] resist.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by physical damage.
Casts your petrify every turn.
Each turn the orb shoots out [2:num_targets] glass shards that deal [16:minion_damage] [physical] damage to random enemies in LOS
Glass orb recasts any self-targeted [enchantment] spell you cast.

Gain [50_physical:physical] resist.
Gain [50_fire:fire] resist.
Gain [50_lightning:lightning] resist.
Gain [50_dark:dark] resist.
Lasts [9_turns:duration].
Also provides resistance to [arcane:arcane], [holy:holy], and [ice:ice].
Whenever you take damage from an enemy, deal [7_lightning:lightning] damage to the source.

Deal [22_fire:fire] damage in a vertical line and [22_holy:holy] damage in a horizontal line.
[Stun] [demon] and [undead] units in the affected area.
Holy Fire deals additional lightning damage on the center tile.
